primary.name: Clip Blue
primary.usage: Primary actions, active states, key highlights

headings.usage: All section titles, card headers, and hero text. Adds a modern, geometric but friendly feel.

body.usage: General text, data tables, and descriptions for maximum legibility.

anti_ai_rules: NO generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical grids for the landing page.
NO full-width solid gradients. Use subtle mesh gradients or white space.
NO 'Inter' for Headings. Use Manrope to give character.
Avoid 100% grey text. Always tint greys with a hint of blue (slate scale).
design_principles.surface_strategy: Card-based Modernism. All content lives in white cards with rounded-2xl corners, subtle 1px slate-200 borders, and soft shadow-sm. This creates a clean, 'lifted' feel against the slate-50 background.
design_principles.spacing_scale: Generous. Use p-6 or p-8 for card padding. Gap-6 for grids. Do not cram data.
design_principles.micro_interactions: Buttons should scale down slightly (0.98) on click. Cards should lift (-2px) on hover with a shadow boost.

cards.base: bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm transition-all duration-200 hover:shadow-md
cards.dashboard_stat: p-6 flex flex-col justify-between relative overflow-hidden

buttons.primary: bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white font-semibold rounded-xl px-6 py-2.5 transition-all shadow-sm hover:shadow-blue-200
buttons.secondary: bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 font-medium rounded-xl px-6 py-2.5 transition-all
buttons.accent: bg-orange-500 hover:bg-orange-600 text-white font-bold rounded-xl px-6 py-2.5 shadow-orange-100

inputs.style: bg-white border-slate-200 focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-100 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-slate-900 placeholder:text-slate-400 transition-all

badges.success: bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-100 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium
badges.warning: bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border border-amber-100 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium
badges.neutral: bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium

dashboard.structure: Sidebar navigation (fixed left) + Main Content Area (scrollable).
dashboard.grid_logic: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6. Hero stats span 3 cols on mobile, 1 col on desktop. Activity feed spans vertical rows.

landing_page.hero: Asymmetrical split. Text left (60%), Image right (40%) with floating decorative elements (earnings cards).
landing_page.features: Zig-zag layout (Text-Image, Image-Text) to guide reading flow.
landing_page.pricing: 3-column grid. Middle card ('Premium') scaled up 1.05x with a border-blue-500 highlight.

assets.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for all UI icons. Use 'solar-icons' (via iconify or similar if available, otherwise fallback to Lucide with rounded style) as requested.

instructions_to_main_agent.step_1: Setup Tailwind config with the brand colors (blue-500, orange-500) and fonts (Manrope, Inter).
instructions_to_main_agent.step_2: Create the base layout components: Sidebar, Topbar, and DashboardWrapper.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_3: Build the 'Auth' pages first. Make them beautiful - split screen with the abstract background on one side and form on the other.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_4: Implement the Dashboard 'Bento' grid. Use the stat cards with icons on the right and big numbers on the left.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_5: Ensure all interactive elements have hover states defined in the components section.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_6: Use the provided image URLs for the landing page hero and features section.
instructions_to_main_agent.critical: Do not use default shadcn cards without adding the specific border/shadow styling defined in 'surface_strategy'. The app must look crisp and light.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES: Always use 'rounded-2xl' for cards and 'rounded-xl' for buttons.
Never use pure black (#000000). Use slate-900 (#0f172a).
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons and inputs.
Ensure the dashboard is responsive: Sidebar becomes a drawer on mobile.
